_comment: Melee contact is proximity-based, not combat-state-based, and NORMAL gets its own containment margin (this PR): two NORMAL-formation Infantry regiments each auto-advance on detecting the other (neither is on HOLD) and meet in the middle. Before this fix, two NORMAL-formation lines in melee contact would fully interleave (soldier marks from both sides checkerboarded across the whole depth of the block, verified against the site showcase clip); this demo shows a real front-to-front clash instead.
